## Contributor Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guidelines.
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] All user-facing strings are localized in both Indonesian (`res/values/strings.xml`) and English (`res/values-en/strings.xml`).
- [ ] No new Android permissions have been added without prior approval.
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, tokens, or passwords are included in the diff.
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has been updated if appropriate.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for UI changes (if applicable).
